This looks like a maraging steel of the C300/C350 type, with about 19.4% Ni, 14.9% Co, 1.45% Mo and 1.55% Ti. Steels with this much Co and Ti are in the 2000+ MPa class. I didn't look up the dataset row, so this is an estimate from the alloy type and not the recorded value. Matbench steels entries for similar compositions are around 1900–2500 MPa, and I'm picking a value in that range.
